experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Deployed the agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda with ECR image pipelines and IAM execution roles for cloud security.
Built a tool-calling LLM agent for a multi-omics cancer research platform using LangChain, AWS Bedrock, and Claude Haiku 4.5.

Wrote a three-tier test framework (tool-level, API/integration, live agent) of ~65 tests across 8 files, validated across the LLM provider migration from Groq to AWS Bedrock after a rate-limit evaluation.
Integrated the agent into a React front end for real-time gene alias enrichment.

experience.title: Data Consultant (AI Engineering & AI System)
bullets: Prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python for a Madrid-based product start-up client, presented in a live stakeholder demo.

Contributed the MCP implementation to the client's production repository (TypeScript/Node.js MCP server, OpenAI query generation, Convex database), now in live day-to-day use; engagement received a 5-star commendation from senior leadership.

experience.title: Freelance AI/ML Engineer
bullets: Built a production RAG and agentic retrieval system (Claude API, LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB) served through a FastAPI REST API in Docker on GCP Cloud Run.
Built scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deployed as FastAPI services in Docker.
